title: Re-review repaired orbit collection blockers
objective: Verify Builder's repair of the orbit collection review blockers and decide whether this can proceed to Git-master.
instructions: Take a focused code-review stance. Verify all previous Inspector findings are fixed or downgraded with evidence.
Pay special attention to output path containment before shutil.rmtree, validation of '.', '..', hidden/path-like names, symlink escapes, non-finite numeric values, and nested orbit spec shapes.
Confirm .gitignore and README are consistent for generated orbit outputs.
Confirm ASpotLight spawn no longer uses rotation= and absolute pose is set after mobility.
Run safe non-simulator checks, including the new unittest file. Do not run simulator-dependent commands.

artifacts: Orbit collection render mode now rejects reserved/hidden/path-like light setting names and verifies real output containment with os.path.commonpath before deletion.

expected_outputs: ResultPacket with findings, tests run, residual live-sim validation requirements, and recommendation: proceed to Git-master or return to Builder.
definition_of_done: Previous critical path-deletion bug is verified fixed.
Non-simulator validation passes or any failure is clearly reported.
